## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the use case or correction. Link the proposal issue and governing
references. For extension changes, state the URI and compatibility impact.

## Validation

Describe checks performed and results, including schema validation.

## Extension checklist

Mark unrelated items as not applicable with an explanation.

- [ ] Extension README (including IANA considerations), SCIM schema, and examples
      are complete.
- [ ] Schema URI and attribute definitions agree across artifacts.
- [ ] Dependencies, absence behavior, conflicts, and compatibility are described.
- [ ] Examples are synthetic and labeled by operation.
- [ ] Security considerations cover authorization, transport, storage, and logging.
- [ ] Main README index and extension README agree on schema URI and registration
      status.
- [ ] For a new extension or semantic change, designated-expert review is requested
      and approval of the final revision is recorded in this PR before merge.
- [ ] Registered status is confirmed against the live IANA registry.
- [ ] Content contains no secrets, internal-only links, or internal identifiers.

## Registration evidence

Status: proposed / registered / not applicable

Link the specification revision and designated-expert review decision. For
post-merge registration updates, link the merged public specification, IANA
request tracking, and confirmed IANA entry as applicable. New extension PRs
require designated-expert approval before merge; the registration request goes
to IANA after merge. Status remains proposed until IANA registration is confirmed.
